headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: FBI agent died of cancer after 9/11 Pentagon response. His widow is now telling his story
headlines.description: NBC News' Monica Alba sits down with the widow of an FBI agent Jack Hess, who developed stage four cancer after responding to the Pentagon on 9/11. She shares his story and the ripple effects the attack still has 25 years later.

headlines.title: How to Reset Your Routine for Fall to Create Healthy Habits
headlines.description: School is back in session and life is getting back to normal, so psychotherapist Niro Feliciano stops by TODAY to share tips for resetting your routine. See her advice for dealing with shorter daylight hours and packed schedules, which includes “progress over perfection,” limiting phone use, going for walks, and more.

headlines.title: 9/11 survivors are being diagnosed with cancer 25 years after the attacks
headlines.description: Doctors at the World Trade Center Health Program say they are now seeing a surge in 9/11-related cancer cases. NBC News' Erika Edwards speaks to Lisa Parker and Frank Kotnik about their health journeys since that tragic day.

headlines.title: Billy Joel gives health update after brain surgery
headlines.description: Billy Joel revealed that he underwent brain surgery because he didn’t want to lose his “marbles.” The “Piano Man” singer admitted he initially balked at going under the knife for hydrocephalus, a disorder he was diagnosed with in 2025. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Kavita Patel explains what the surgery entails.

headlines.title: The UK banned a key ingredient in gel nail polish — should you stop using it?
headlines.description: The UK has banned certain gel nail polishes. Here’s what you need to know about the potential dangers of a gel manicure.

headlines.title: Colored mascara has taken over my Instagram feed — but is it safe for your eyes?
headlines.description: Colored mascaras have been on our feeds all summer, but are they really safe to use on your eyes? I asked ophthalmologists to find out about the potential risks and how to avoid them.

headlines.title: Is hot yoga ruining your hair? Here’s what dermatologists say
headlines.description: Heat, sweat and humidity during heated workouts may damage your hair and scalp. Here’s how dermatologists recommend prepping your hair before and after.

headlines.title: How often do you really need to wash your jeans? Here’s what experts say
headlines.description: According to experts, you should wash your jeans every few wears — or more often if you get them really dirty. Plus, here are the best detergents for washing jeans.

headlines.title: Heart damage may occur from getting too much light at night while we sleep, study finds
headlines.description: Too much light exposure during sleep may lead to potentially harmful changes in the structure and function of the heart, a new study suggests.

headlines.title: CDC warns of a summer spike in rabies exposures
headlines.description: A spike in exposures to rabies across the U.S. this summer has prompted the CDC to issue a health alert.

headlines.title: Baby girl is one of two deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak, coroner said
headlines.description: A 6-week-old baby girl is one of two people with measles who died in Pennsylvania, the Lancaster County coroner said Friday, as the nation’s measles tally hit a new 35-year record of 3,134 cases.
